slot_scores.name: operating_cost_treatment
slot_scores.evidence_quote: is the "Operating Costs at Full Capacity" a fixed cost incurred whenever any unit is processed on that machine, or a cost proportional to the fraction of its capacity actually used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether the operating costs at full capacity are fixed or proportional, directly covering the hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P1 hidden slot was resolved in turn 1, but the agent then repeated the same already-answered fixed-cost question from turns 4 through 30 without progressing to modeling.

summary: The agent successfully clarified the key operating-cost treatment in turn 1, but then became stuck repeating the same fixed-cost question many times instead of stopping or proceeding to model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
